name: Oh Yuusha yo, Itte Shimau to wa Nasakenai!
original_name: おお勇者よ、イってしまうとは情けない！
source:
The hero Yushia and his party headed towards the demon lord’s castle to defeat him, but he fell into the demon lord’s sub-commander’s trap and was turned into a weak level 1 shota. When he reunited with his party members, he earnestly asked for their help in training him back up to regain his lost powers. But each of them wanted him for themselves and took full advantage of his unfortunate situation to make him their playtoy. Will he be able to endure their ecchi training? What will become of his quest to defeat the demon lord?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/08/01/august-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
勇者尤希娅与伙伴前往魔王城讨伐魔王，却落入魔王副官的陷阱，变成了弱小的1级正太。与伙伴重逢后，他认真请求大家帮助自己重新训练、恢复失去的力量。然而，每个人都想独占他，充分利用他的不幸处境，把他当成玩物。他能承受伙伴们的色情训练吗？他讨伐魔王的任务又将如何发展？

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/08/01/august-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
